fields.description: The File this workbook belongs to, by name. Data and unique rather than a Link so the row is addressable as `Sheet Book/<file>` — one statement to load, no filter.
fields.label: Sheet

fields.description: The workbook: every tab, cell, formula, format, merge, named range, pivot and chart, as the gzipped envelope `codec.py` reads. Never edited here — a save replaces it whole, which is what the editor does.
fields.label: Payload

fields.description: Uncompressed size of the payload. The number a size cap has to be measured against, since the compressed one says nothing about what opening it costs.
fields.label: Byte Size

fields.description: How many saves this workbook has had. Version history is not built; this is the counter it would hang off, and it costs nothing to keep.
fields.label: Head Seq
